title: New Relic Review (2026)
intro: New Relic is evaluated here as an observability and infrastructure monitoring suite — New Relic is an all-in-one observability platform (APM, infra, logs, traces) billed on data ingest plus user type. Every edition includes 100 GB/month free ingest. Original data is $0.40/GB beyond that (Data Plus $0.60/GB). Basic users are free; Core users $49; Standard full-platform users start at $10 for the first then $99 (max 5). Pro full users are $349/user annual ($418.80 monthly). Enterprise is contact. Distinct from Datadog’s per-host infrastructure SKU. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s IT & Development methodology (ease of use, IT job fit, workflow depth, integrations, admin/security, scalability, value, AI), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose New Relic when unified observability billed on ingest + users is the job — not Datadog host packs and not ITSM.
verdict: Choose New Relic when unified observability billed on ingest + users is the job — not Datadog host packs and not ITSM. Compare Datadog for host/module packaging; Grafana Cloud for OSS-aligned usage; PagerDuty for on-call. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-18 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, host/GB rates and minimums on the vendor site before purchase.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Unified NRQL/platform is powerful; pricing dimensions (users + GB) add buying friction.
Observability suite — peer of Datadog/Grafana Cloud, not Freshservice.
APM + logs + infra + traces in one product is deep; held at 9 vs Datadog’s modular breadth.
Broad APM language/cloud integrations; incident paging still often PagerDuty.
Pro/Enterprise add governance; Standard is SMB-grade.
Data + user model scales; Pro user list price is steep.
Generous 100 GB free; full-user list prices are the gotcha vs Datadog host SKUs. Affiliate economics excluded.
Platform AI assistance exists; not the buying reason vs APM depth.

bestFor: Teams that want APM + logs + infra in one ingest bill
Orgs that can live with 1–5 Standard full users
Buyers comparing usage-based observability to Datadog hosts
notIdealFor: Teams standardised on Grafana OSS + cheap Cloud Pro usage
pros: Pro path for unlimited full users
limitations: Full-platform user prices jump hard after the $10 first seat (Standard) and again at Pro $349
Ingest $0.40/GB after 100 GB is the other TCO lever vs Datadog hosts
Standard caps at 5 full users — growing teams are pushed to Pro
Not an ITSM service desk or git host
Compute/CCU add-ons can appear on advanced capabilities
pricingSummary: Free 100 GB + 1 full user. Standard from $10 first full user. Data $0.40/GB after 100 GB. Pro $349/full user annual. Confirm on newrelic.com/pricing.
whoShouldChoose: Choose New Relic when unified observability billed on ingest + users is the job — not Datadog host packs and not ITSM.
whoShouldConsiderAlternatives: Compare Datadog for host/module packaging; Grafana Cloud for OSS-aligned usage; PagerDuty for on-call.

faq.answer: Free 100 GB + 1 full user. Standard from $10 first full user. Data $0.40/GB after 100 GB. Pro $349/full user annual. Confirm on newrelic.com/pricing.

faq.answer: Yes — a free plan is published. No free trial is documented on the pricing page. Confirm current terms with the vendor.

faq.answer: No. This review is based on first-party product and pricing research evidence, not hands-on product usage. Affiliate relationships never influence scores.
